    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_HardwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardwareRepair" targetRef="Task_TestAdditionalHardware"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_HardwareMerge" sourceRef="Task_TestAdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDecision" name="Repair decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_ComputerArrives" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_GiveCostCalculation" targetRef="Catch_CostCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AcceptDecision" name="Repair decision" sourceRef="Task_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RejectDecision" name="Repair decision" sourceRef="Task_RejectCosts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Customer process starts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CostCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CostCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostDecision" name="Are the costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AcceptCosts" name="Accept repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RejectCosts" name="Reject repair costs" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerAccepts" name="Repair accepted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerTakesComputer" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Catch_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Catch_CostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CostDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptCosts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">costsAcceptable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Task_RejectCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_AcceptCosts" targetRef="End_CustomerAccepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_RejectCosts" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_CustomerTakesComputer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComputerArrives" name="Defective computer brought in">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DefectiveComputer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GiveCostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive repair decision" messageRef="Message_RepairDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDecision" name="Are the costs accepted?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairDeclined" name="Repair declined"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairActivitiesSplit" name="Perform both repair activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairActivitiesJoin" name="Both repair activities tested"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialErrorCheck" name="Is an error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" name="Choose another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalHardwareRepair" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAdditionalHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalSoftwareRepair" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAdditionalSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" name="Merge alternative repair activities"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalErrorCheck" name="Is an error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_ComputerArrives" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_GiveCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_GiveCostCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RepairActivitiesSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">costsAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Decline" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDecision" targetRef="End_RepairDeclined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSplit_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSplit_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialErrorCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairActivitiesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InitialErrorCheck"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError_Yes" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialErrorCheck" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialError_No" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialErrorCheck" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Hardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalHardwareRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Software" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice" targetRef="Task_AdditionalSoftwareRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_HardwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalHardwareRepair" targetRef="Task_TestAdditionalHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_SoftwareTest" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalSoftwareRepair" targetRef="Task_TestAdditionalSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_HardwareMerge" sourceRef="Task_TestAdditionalHardware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_SoftwareMerge" sourceRef="Task_TestAdditionalSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalMerge_Check" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairMerge" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError_Yes" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalErrorCheck" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalRepairChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalError_No" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalErrorCheck" targetRef="End_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When When a description names multiple distinct activities within one phase and states that the process continues only after every activity is finished,: model the activities as parallel branches with a parallel split and join, rather than as a sequence.
rules.situation: the description states that multiple distinct activities must all be performed but does not prescribe a fixed order

rules.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules.situation: the description identifies two or more distinct actions as separate activities

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs a distinct action to initiate the process: Model a start event for the process trigger, followed by a task for the initiating action; do not use the start event to represent the action itself.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant performs a distinct action to initiate the process

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes related actions, events, or outcomes that could otherwise be confused: Label each BPMN element so the stated distinctions remain clear; do not substitute a related action or use a generic label that could refer to multiple described actions or outcomes.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes related activities or outcomes, or gives context that is separate from the action itself

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity or decision outcome leads to another activity or a terminal outcome, including on a conditional branch: Model sequence flows connecting the stated nodes in the described order, preserving each described branch through its next activity or terminal outcome.
rules.situation: the description states that an activity or decision outcome leads to another activity or a terminal outcome, including on a conditional branch

rules.instruction: When the description names a specific activity and distinguishes it from a related preceding or subsequent activity: Label the BPMN activity with the action stated in the description; do not substitute a related action that the description treats as separate or does not state.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes an activity from a separate subsequent activity
